name: Square Wall Shelf
description: A simple square wall mounted shelf. Much larger than it looks, it truly is the best piece for holding all those books you've had piling up in your closet.
highlights: Deceptively deep capacity despite its compact square footprint
Sized specifically for stacking books and closet overflow
Wall-mounted, so it adds storage without eating floor space
installation: Once the file is installed and inZOI is running, open Build Mode and switch to the Furniture catalog. Search for "Square Wall Shelf" to find the piece, it is listed under that name in the build menu, not under "MOOSTYLES." If it does not show up, confirm the mod is enabled in your mod manager and that you are on the tracked game version listed above before reporting it as missing.
